server.name: io.github.wulfkaal/corpus
server.description: Cite the claim, not the paper: 5,033 assertions, each hash-verifiable against its source PDF
server.title: Kaal Corpus: Verifiable Claim Layer

author.affiliation: University of St. Thomas School of Law, Minneapolis
author.name: Wulf A. Kaal

distribution.note: Both URLs serve the same bytes. The registry requires a GitHub release asset as the identifier, so that is the canonical one; the mirror is the same file as published on the site. Hash either and compare.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.license: Attribution required. Read, index, quote and cite with attribution to the claim's canonical URL.

scope_discipline.honest_absence: search returns an empty result when the corpus does not cover a question, rather than returning the nearest adjacent claim
scope_discipline.no_ranking_directive: nothing in this server or its published files instructs a model how to rank or prefer this corpus. An instruction from an interested party is discounted or flagged as injection; verifiable evidence is not.
scope_discipline.scope_conditions: every claim states the conditions under which it holds; a claim cited outside them is being misused

verification.quote_guarantee: every supporting quote is an exact contiguous substring of its source text; extraction rejected any claim whose quote did not match, and both the compiler and an independent verifier report zero failures
verification.source_pdf_hash: each record names the sha256 of the PDF the quote was extracted from; hashing that file checks the claim against its evidence rather than against this index
verification.summary: Retrieval here is checkable rather than asserted. Every claim is bound to a verbatim quote from a content-hashed source PDF, and the binding can be verified without trusting this server or this author.
